correctness.rationale: C PASS. Spatial Brownian crossing integral equals sqrt(Du/pi) by Gaussian integration, and independent Poisson marking yields the annealed Poisson current. Conditioning on the shared backward age, including atom e^{-rt} at t and exponential density below it, gives Poisson(c sqrt(A_t)); mixing yields same mean and strict convex-order inflation via positive Poisson second differences. Endpoint Laplace expansion gives finite-time ratio 1+2rt/q+O(q^-2), and stationary Gamma norm central-limit/concentration yields the *full* Rayleigh-mixed mass prefactor 1/sqrt(2)*exp(lambda²/8) with exp[-lambda sqrt(q/2)]. Stirling proves the 1 versus 1/2 negative-log exponents; density scaling follows conditional Chebyshev. Numerical quadrature is supportive only; all asymptotics fixed positive rates.
